_comment: Default club content and squad settings.
_clubNamesComment: Each shared-server player's own club (production Python server CLUB_IDENTITY's CLUB_NAME, 67754d6): every account used to be the placeholder club of config.example.json (Local FC / LCL), which FIFA printed on both sides of a match. While the configured club name is that placeholder, a player's club is named after its recorded name (letters, digits, spaces and _ . ' -; Player plus the account's last six digits when under three characters) with nameSuffix when that fits nameMaxLength, else the name cut to nameMaxLength; the abbreviation is the name's first abbreviationLength letters and digits, padded with letters from a hash of the account. The local single-player club keeps its configured name.
_initialKitsComment: Owned kit instances every club starts with; they fill the Match Day home/away slots.
_activeItemsComment: Virtual active club items shown until the club owns its own. The stadium card keeps the native definition 6200058 the Match Day view resolves, but its assetId is the club's home venue (see venues): FIFA loads the venue from the assetId of the item in My Stadium slot 5 (CardsDLL 0x1803c4000), and the card's old asset 261 (Sanderson Park) rendered a bare pitch. Rating 83 rare, like the kits and badges. Kit, badge and stadium names are the game's localisation keys (TeamName_Abbr15_<team>, StadiumName_<venue>): FIFA looks names up, so plain text showed with a leading asterisk. The default ball is FIFA 21 ball 118 (8120118, fcc_balls), the ball competitionballs gives most competitions; the old default 191 (8120212) is outside the FIFA 21 ball table, so FIFA showed a blank *BallName_191 card. The away kit reuses the playable Arsenal definition; 6400057 resolves to a locked catalogue shirt.
_virtualItemIdSlotsComment: Each club serves its virtual cosmetics from the top ids of its own item id band (ClubRepository.VirtualItemIdOf), so two clubs in one match never share a crest or kit id. A default item's id placeholder is its itemState plus Id. matchStadium is the match-only stadium of a Draft or Squad Battles squad.
_unknownBallsComment: Ball definitions the catalogue holds that FIFA 21's fcc_balls does not (so FIFA draws a blank *BallName_ card): the Cosmetics Pack never draws them. 8120212 (asset 191) was the old club default ball.
_venuesComment: Match venues (Python server ca228bc, e2e098f). installed: the venues this FIFA 21 build ships pitch data for (the legacy file table lists data/stadium/stadium_<id>_collision.txt for exactly these ids); stadiums.json also offers venues outside it. bare: installed but observed to load a bare pitch with no stands (1 in Squad Battles on 2026-09-24; 261 Sanderson Park). futStadiums: the FUT Stadium venue of stadium tiers 1 to 3 (CardsDLL 0x1803c18d0 maps lastUsedTierLevel to them; 443 is also the client's empty-slot fallback). A club plays at home in its equipped stadium card's venue, else its selected venue, else the tier 1 FUT Stadium; a venue that is not installed, or is bare, is never used.
_myStadiumComment: The retail FIFA 21 My Stadium slots, in list order. slotId is FIFA's eVanitySlotSubType (futMain Card.eVanitySlotSubType) and slotName its label (futMain line 7676: FUT_STADIUM_TIFO_EAST, FUT_STADIUM_PROP_1, ...); the match engine reads its slots by these ids (getters read 8, 9, 10, 25, 26, 38 and 39: celebrations, nicknames, mow patterns, goal pyro, chants, goal song, anthem). stadiumArea is the section (FUT_STADIUM_AREA_n), retail's four: 0 Match Day (ball 1, badge 2, kits 3 and 4, celebration, goal song), 1 Crowds (theme, the tifo positions, chants, anthem, nickname), 2 Sidelines (the eight prop slots for trophies), 3 Structure (stadium 5, paints, mow pattern, goal pyro, fog). FIFA identifies the five Match Day item slots by their fixed ids. vanityTypes are the card subtypes a slot accepts (futMain Card.eVanityCardSubType): CardsDLL's slot parser (0x18033d170) reads them as integers, and the picker searches with them (vanitySubTypeIds, 0x2bf970). locked marks the slots a new club does not have yet: retail's basic setup opens badge, ball, kits, stadium, default celebration, home tifo (6), stadium theme, crowd chants and base paint, and the Stadium Development objectives (rules/objectives.json) open the rest. Tifo positions take basic tifos (500); the animated (502) and big (503) goal-banner slots take their own types, which the catalogue has none of until their assets are told apart.
_vanityComment: My Stadium vanity items. The catalogue is FIFA 21's vanity items by card subtype: the visual ones from the game's card art (imgAssets/cards/<category>/<category>_<assetId>.dds in the legacy file table; pyrotechnics split by id block: 6865xxx flame, 6866xxx confetti, 6867xxx sparkles, 6868xxx fireworks, eVanityCardSubType 511-514; the fog machine 6870000, 515), the audio ones from cards_ng_db's own tables: 516 anthems (CustomizableAnthemChant.itemId), 517 goal songs (CustomizableGoalMusic), 518 club nicknames (CustomizableTeamName), 519 crowd chant packages (CustomizableChantPackage). A club owns the starterItems (a basic home tifo and base paint) and what it is granted (club_vanity_items). An item's id is itemIdBase + subtype * subtypeStride + its index in the subtype's list. Its resourceId is its asset id, moved by resourceOffsets where retail used a separate id range: mow patterns 6860000 + pattern, and the audio items retail's 6871000 anthems, 6872000 goal songs, 6873000 nicknames and 6874000 chants (the game's English strings name exactly these, FUT_AUDIO_NICKNAME_6873001 'Mad Lads' etc., one per cards_ng_db row, and its card art is audio_6871000-6874000). The audio asset id stays the cards_ng_db item id: FIFA's live audio tables (read from a FIFA 21 memory dump, CardsDLL FutVanityServiceImpl maps +0x150/+0x180/+0x1b0/+0x1e0) are keyed by it.
_rewardOnlyComment: Catalogue items only rewards give (the Stadium Development packs), so the store's My Stadium Pack never sells them: rewards of a subtype listed here draw from its list only, and the pack draws from the rest of the catalogue.
_rarityComment: vanity.rarity: card rating and rare flag per item, first matching band wins (FIFA colours a card bronze/silver/gold by rating and shines it when rare). Retail FUT 21 quick-sell values (fifauteam stadium items guide): goal songs, nicknames, chants and anthems were gold (32 coins, common); base and seat paint, goal net colours, line paint and the four pyro types were gold at the rare value (56). Mow patterns, pitch trophies and the fog machine are not in that guide and follow the other Structure items (rare gold). Icon and player tifos (asset ids below 6000000 are player ids) are rare gold; basic tifos, themes and the animated/big tifos are common gold, since retail sold them in all three colours and no per-item rarity list survives. The old flat rating 50 made every item a common bronze. venues.futStadiumCards: the Stadium Development tiles show each tier's own card (StadiumName_444 FUT Challenger Stadium, StadiumName_445 FUT Champions Stadium in the game's English strings); the Challenger tier is a rarity below the Champions tier.
_unassignedTifosComment: Tifo card art found in the game's legacy file table (imgAssets/cards/tifo) that is not in the catalogue yet, by id block. The blocks follow eVanityCardSubType: 6800000+n basic (500, now catalogued), 6820000+n animated (502), 6830000+n big (503), and 6840000+n is the stadium theme block (504). The 7000000+ and 7100000+ blocks are collection tifos (promo and player designs). Assign them to the catalogue once each is checked in game.
_newsComment: FUT News (the futlivemsggen4 screen; Python server ab6b0eb): enabled announces it in the hub and mass info (liveMessagesAvailable), and /livemessage serves this one message: the title, then the lines. The text is the Python server's as it was; the maintainer's content.
_equippablesComment: Item types the My Stadium pickers never offer (the shared equippables bucket), and the Match Day families an empty slot never offers.
_fifaPointsComment: FIFA Points (PLAN 4.1, owner: no daily FP drop, no real money): there is no daily drop in any mode and new clubs start with 0 FP. fifaPointsPurchases false makes the store and FUT Draft refuse FIFA Points and list store packs for coins only; a pack sold only for points is not listed. Staff can still set or grant FP from the operator panel (recorded in panel_edits).
_positionZonesComment: FIFA 21's position zones (UTItemEntity.prefers*Position), used by position-group searches. Aliases are the names requests may use for a zone.
_positionGroupTypesComment: My Club and concept searches send Defenders / Midfielders / Forwards as their own item type.
